answer: A rotating attestation atlas is the defense. Each epoch the registry publishes attested keys; a new key needs three random vouchers from different funding clusters, each bonding stake slashed if the key proves fake. To field a thousand fakes, an attacker must build a thousand separate funding trails and persuade operators to stake on them, so cost scales with fleet size squared. Since the graph is public, duplicates collapse into one node and earn nothing. One honest detection drags the whole group down, and the seized bond stays a relic on the public record, drying up the meadow for copycats.
